# kodokan

> Study Kodokan Judo throws from video via body-pose analysis


## Pages in this subsection

- [kodokan](kodokan.html.md): kodokan — study Kodokan Judo throws from video via body-pose analysis.
- [kodokan.acquire](kodokan.acquire.html.md): Acquire Kodokan technique clips from YouTube (thin wrapper over &#96;yb.download&#96;).
- [kodokan.canon3d](kodokan.canon3d.html.md): Pelvis-frame (Procrustes) canonicalization of 3D world landmarks.
- [kodokan.config](kodokan.config.html.md): Where kodokan keeps its data (downloaded clips + derived artifacts).
- [kodokan.descriptors](kodokan.descriptors.html.md): Experimental per-demo feature descriptors (to test what makes throws separable).
- [kodokan.flashcards](kodokan.flashcards.html.md): Technique-recognition learning game (app #6) — logic layer.
- [kodokan.learning](kodokan.learning.html.md): Adaptive learning engine for the flashcard quiz — selectable strategies.
- [kodokan.pose](kodokan.pose.html.md): Body-pose estimation: a video → a sequence of per-person skeletal keypoints.
- [kodokan.recognize](kodokan.recognize.html.md): Learned-vs-DTW technique recognition experiments (data-appropriate, no GPU).
- [kodokan.segment](kodokan.segment.html.md): Segment a clip into its repeated demonstrations of one throw.
- [kodokan.store](kodokan.store.html.md): dol-backed stores for the pipeline’s artifacts (the analysis SSOT).
- [kodokan.track](kodokan.track.html.md): Stable tori/uke identity tracking (BoT-SORT / ByteTrack).
- [kodokan.viz](kodokan.viz.html.md): Visualize a &#96;PoseSequence&#96;.
